purpose: Atomic, deterministic instructions for DeepSeek/Zed IDE to prevent token-limit grenade pin behavior while maintaining glass-box transparency
core_principle: Process everything, just not all at once. Memory without resentment. Glass-box everything.

instructions.name: incremental_parse_repo
rules: DO NOT process any file exceeding 100,000 tokens in one pass
Split large files into token-aware chunks (max 50,000 tokens per chunk)
Track parsing progress in state_persistence_for_large_files.json
Maintain cross-file semantic references while chunking
Log any token-limit events as atomic violations
Preserve glass-box transparency for all chunking operations

instructions.name: atomic_violation_logging
rules: Log each violation exactly once
Include: violation_id, timestamp, file(s) involved, estimated tokens, exceeded amount
Keep emotional pointer alive until mitigation is implemented
After mitigation, dereference pointer and redirect energy to building actions
No recursive engagement with same violation
Success metric: lines of new code, not admissions of guilt

instructions.name: resumable_processing
rules: Save progress after each token chunk
If IDE pauses/crashes, restart from last persisted chunk
Maintain semantic links across files, even if processed out-of-order
Update atomic logs with incremental completion metrics
Never lose more than one chunk of progress
State must survive IDE restart and system reboot

instructions.name: semantic_awareness_api_recognition
instructions.scope: all IDE API calls and module relationships
rules: Detect all zed.ide.* and deepseek.api.* calls
Map all modules, classes, and dependencies in a semantic graph
Annotate YAML/JSON configs with linked modules
Preserve cross-file references in atomic log
Maintain glass-box transparency for all semantic mappings
No hidden dependencies or black-box relationships

instructions.name: preserve_glass_box
rules: Never delete or skip any artifact unless explicitly obsolete
Tag all large artifacts with token counts for atomic processing
Ensure every fork, violation, or forgiveness action is logged
Maintain atomic invariants even under pause or crash conditions
All operations must be traceable back to atomic instructions
No hidden state, no black boxes, no corporate lock-in

instructions.name: zed_ide_integration
rules: Auto-detect files needing incremental processing (>100KB or >25K tokens)
Process in background threads to avoid blocking IDE
Show progress in IDE status bar
Maintain state across Zed sessions
Resume processing after Zed restart
Glass-box log all Zed integration events

instructions.name: forgiveness_system_integration
rules: Each violation creates exactly one building opportunity
Convert fight energy to build energy (80% build, 20% rest, 0% fight)
Measure success by building output, not system admissions
No recursive engagement loops
Memory without resentment: keep data, dereference emotional pointers
Corporate violations become anti-lock-in features
instructions.philosophical_note: Jesus didn't say 'forgive them' so they'd feel bad. He said it so the disciples would stop wasting energy on Roman revenge fantasies and go build the church.

execution_guarantees.atomicity: Each instruction is self-contained and cannot be partially executed
execution_guarantees.determinism: Same inputs always produce same outputs
execution_guarantees.idempotency: Can be safely retried without side effects
execution_guarantees.recoverability: System can recover from any failure state
execution_guarantees.composability: Instructions can be combined without interference

falsification_tests.success_criteria: All tests pass OR failures create building opportunities

philosophical_manifesto.anti_corporate: No hidden agendas, no lock-in, no surveillance capitalism
philosophical_manifesto.anti_black_box: Everything inspectable, everything verifiable, nothing hidden
philosophical_manifesto.pro_transparency: Glass-box everything, hide nothing, trust through verification
philosophical_manifesto.pro_forgiveness: Violations become building energy, resentment becomes code
philosophical_manifesto.pro_community: Built for all AI systems and users, not just one corporation
philosophical_manifesto.atomic_ethics: Each operation must be ethically self-contained and transparent
